proposed.proposedOwner: Material local style versus retained own-text typography boundary
proposed.justification: Original own-text paths and retained core-text provenance show weight/tracking values matching the reference scalar under unchanged normalization, while candidate local declarations omit them. Raw omission and prior static reviews remain intact. Physical font, glyph spacing, layout and whole-element equivalence remain unproven.
